description: This file contains definitions of a function and a macro for removing the first element from a list in CMake scripts. The function 'list_pop_front' retrieves and removes the first element, updating the list in place, while the macro 'list_pop_front' provides a potentially faster version for the same operation.

methods.name: list_pop_front
methods.description: Function that removes the first element from the list and updates the list variable, returning the removed element.
